15 bar water on air dry soil is the gravimetric water content of <2 mm air dry samples after equilibration at 15 bars water tension. It is reported on a <2 mm base. The value is influenced by clay %, mineralogy, and organic carbon %.

Airdry/ovendry H2O ratio is the ratio of air dry gravimetric percent water over oven dry (105 degrees C) gravimetric percent water. If gypsum is present, this ratio is corrected for crystal water in the gypsum.

Airdry/ovendry H2O ratio is the ratio of air dry gravimetric percent water over oven dry (105 degrees C) gravimetric percent water. If gypsum is present, this ratio is corrected for crystal water in the gypsum.

The ratio of 15 bar H2O percent / clay percent is calculated by (W15AD or W15FM)/CLAY_TOT, reported as grams per gram, on a <2 mm base. It provides inferences about clay mineralogy and the effectiveness of dispersion in the particle size analysis.
